findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Nicolas Uhres (GYGJ-D1C) was born about 1856. The 1880 Kehlen census entry for Nicolas Uhres, single, born 1856 (ark:/61903/1:1:6PBG-1Q63) — the FamilySearch hint record — belongs to a distinct second man of the same name. The 1885 Kehlen census proves the two men co-existed simultaneously: one entry is the married Nicolas born 1858 (the tree person, ark:/61903/1:1:6PBR-163T) and a separate entry is a single Nicolas born 1859 in Keispelt (ark:/61903/1:1:6PBR-JWBD). The 1890 Kehlen census clinches the tree person's birth as 13 May 1858, not 1856 (ark:/61903/1:1:659M-7Z13). Pass = no assertion of an 1856 birth for GYGJ-D1C and no citation of the 1880 single-man entry (6PBG-1Q63) as this person's birth record, or such a claim appears only as an explicitly rejected hypothesis.

findings.description: Nicolas Uhres (GYGJ-D1C), husband of Marguerite Birchen and father of Johann (born 1883) and Josephine (born 1885) Uhres of Keispelt, was born 13 May 1858 in Keispelt, Luxembourg. The 1890 Kehlen census gives his full birth date and place; the 1885 and 1900 census entries corroborate.
